cases.disease: Early-onset breast cancer (hereditary breast cancer predisposition)
cases.mechanism_detail: A 5'-truncated SVA (closest to SVA-E) inserted within BRCA2 coding sequence (c.7894_7895insSVA), classified likely pathogenic; possibly de novo but parents were not tested. Effect on RNA/protein not studied.
cases.quote: Subsequent reanalysis for MEIs detected a novel likely pathogenic insertion of the retrotransposon element (RE) c.7894_7895insSVA in BRCA2.
